items.title: Fadnavis alleges paid, possibly foreign, money boosted Jantar Mantar protest content
items.summary: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis (speaking Oct 12) claimed money was given to boost content at Jantar Mantar, possibly from foreign sources, and pointed to past agitations where social media algorithms were manipulated to spread chaos — while accusing the INDIA bloc/protesters of targeting constitutional bodies and backing the CJI's stance.

items.title: Dipke dares Fadnavis: act through police, ED, CBI and jail those responsible
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke responded (Oct 13, PTI footage) to Fadnavis's paid/foreign-money claim about Jantar Mantar protest content, asking what Fadnavis was waiting for and daring him to have the police, ED and CBI take action and jail whoever is responsible.
